top_band: sloped grey tiled roof (rows 1-15) and stone water basin top with water opening (rows 29-35)
evidence: The structure has a 15-row sloped tile roof (rows 1-15) with an eave shadow (row 16), wooden support pillars (rows 17-43), and a stone water basin at the bottom showing a 7-row top surface (rows 29-35) with an inset 4-row water opening (rows 31-34) above a 7-row front stone face (rows 36-42).

style.evidence: While the roof has decent tile shading (5 steps), the wooden pillars and the entire stone water basin below are rendered with large un-textured flat fills (e.g. a 14x6 block of flat grey on the basin front, flat 2-tone vertical strips for pillars) enclosed in heavy near-black outlines, looking much flatter and simpler than the textured stone and wood on the Beodeul references.
